mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_transactions (id, order_id, gateway_id, gateway_transaction_id, amount, currency, status, raw_response, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{orderId}, #{gatewayId}, #{gatewayTransactionId}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{status}, #{rawResponse, typeHandler=com.example.backend.config.JsonNodeTypeHandler}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_transactions SET order_id = #{orderId}, gateway_id = #{gatewayId}, gateway_transaction_id = #{gatewayTransactionId}, amount = #{amount}, currency = #{currency}, status = #{status}, raw_response = #{rawResponse, typeHandler=com.example.backend.config.JsonNodeTypeHandler}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, gateway_id, gateway_transaction_id, amount, currency, status, created_at FROM payment_transactions ORDER BY created_at DESC
